items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: In that same week they had to play at Town Hall one night and accompany Billie Holiday.

ctx.x: I think that’s who either come by to get me or something. I started with them right at the Savoy. In that same week they had to play at Town Hall one night and accompany Billie Holiday. So I was really into that.
That’s well documented. That history with you, and the use of the word “slave.” He said – what did he say?
